d: Honey blonde hair is styled in a chin-length, wavy bob with a side part and swept-back bangs. The amber-colored eyes have a narrow, confident expression, accompanied by a thin vertical scar over the right eyelid on a youthful face. The slender build is dressed in a dark navy blue blazer with gold trim over a white collared shirt and a black necktie. A black glove is worn on the right hand, which holds a black and gold revolver.
